comparison.objective: Bimanually pour simulated molten metal into the safe mould; candidate separates dry media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-handle vessel transport, hazard selection, and direct granular pour versus supported-screen loading and orientation-dependent sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Charge reaches dry mould with limited spill and crucible returned versus media passes screen while every washer remains.
comparison.reason: Shared controlled pouring is generic; the candidate uniquely tests aperture separation, bridging, and retained oversize parts.
